classes.name: EntityNotCondition
classes.description: Represents a negated entity condition, encapsulating another EntityCondition to invert its result.

methods.name: EntityNotCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the negation condition with a provided EntityCondition.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to perform operations based on the visitor pattern.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, returning true if they are both EntityNotCondition instances with equal inner conditions.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the string 'NOT' and the inner condition's hash code.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Indicates whether this condition is empty; returns false.

methods.name: makeWhereString
methods.description: Builds the SQL-like string representation of the negated condition.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Validates the inner condition against a ModelEntity, may throw a GenericModelException.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Evaluates whether the condition matches given the context, returning the inverse of the inner condition's result.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the condition, delegating to makeWhereString.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Returns a frozen (immutable) version of this condition.
